visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An Asian male with short black hair and a dark blue crewneck sweater stands in a brightly lit indoor studio or living room. He holds a white iPhone 16 Pro with a small, square silver-and-white SSD attached to the back. The background shows a white curtain and a blurred shelf with decorative items. (2) The scene cuts to a night exterior; the man is wearing glasses and a beige-and-black varsity jacket, holding the phone to capture a photo of a brightly lit storefront with neon signs. (3) Returning to the studio, the man talks to the camera, gesturing with his hands. He wears a small lavalier microphone on his collar. (4) A close-up shot features a hand holding the AGI EDM38 SSD, a white square device with a silver metal frame and a small 'AGI' logo. (5) In the studio, the man holds up his palm to emphasize a point while continuing his explanation. (6) A high-detail close-up of the product's packaging highlights numerical specs like '2TB' and '1800 MB/s' in green and black text. (7) A close-up demonstrates the MagSafe function: the SSD is seen snapping magnetically onto the back of the white iPhone. (8) A different filming setup is shown where the iPhone is mounted inside a complex black camera rig (rabbit cage) with cables attached. (9) The man is seen from the side outdoors, taking a horizontal photo using the phone-and-SSD combo. (10) A hand is shown plugging a short braided USB-C cable from the SSD into the side of a silver laptop resting on a wooden table. (11) The setting shifts to a crowded night street in Korea; the man walks toward the camera, speaking into a handheld microphone. Passersby are visible in the background. (12) A screen capture of a MacBook interface displays a file directory containing folders labeled with dates and project names like '2024 韓國對抗賽'. (13) The man returns to the studio setting, pointing toward the audience as he concludes his presentation.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 支援磁吸在手機上的超小SSD!. [Subtitle]: 跟大家分享一下. (2) [Subtitle]: 我最近我出國拍攝很常使用 iPhone 16 Pro 來補畫面. (3) [Subtitle]: 但拍久了手機空間真的不夠用. (4) [Subtitle]: 直到我用上了這一款 AGI EDM38 磁吸式固態硬碟. (5) [Logo]: AGi. [Slogan]: AGI EDM38 磁吸式固態硬碟. [Subtitle]: 才真正的解決了我的容量焦慮. (6) [Subtitle]: 它不但有 2TB 的超大容量 還有著超快的讀寫速度. (7) [Subtitle]: 並且支援了 Apple ProRaw 拍攝規格. (8) [Subtitle]: 重點是 大家有沒有看到 哎呀 它支援 MagSafe. (9) [Subtitle]: 所以你不用像我們之前用兔籠幫 iPhone 接 SSD. (10) [Subtitle]: 只要輕輕一吸 就可以透過它跟 iPhone 傳遞各種資料 用起來非常的方便 不卡手. (11) [Subtitle]: 重點是 極小的體積. (12) [Slogan]: 極小的體積. [Subtitle]: 你要把它當作一般辦公公用. (13) [Subtitle]: 或拍攝用的隨身硬碟也沒有問題. (14) [Subtitle]: 像我們之前去韓國拍攝的行程 就帶著它. (15) [Subtitle]: 不然黑白大廚的素材量 真的是很恐怖. (16) [Subtitle]: 那如果你跟我一樣 很常使用手機拍影片 有容量焦慮的人 可以參考看看
